newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers dip, Mediterranean stable.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers dip, Mediterranean stable.

text.p: Rotterdam bunkers fell $1/$2 a tonne on Tuesday as barges came off, while most prices in the rest of Europe were stable, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at around $83/$84 fob. Some larger players offered as low as $82.50 fob, a mere 50 cents above the ex-wharf price.
The aggressive selling, however, drew few buyers. Initial enquiries suggested volumes would succeed 10,000 tonnes by the close, but a couple of larger buyers decided to postpone by the afternoon.
Hamburg prices dipped slightly to keep in line with Rotterdam. Trading was thin.
Mediterranean prices were little changed. Most ports were quiet.
Egyptian prices were likewise stable and product was available in all ports.
